card.name: Words just before drug-risk or interaction terms
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word parts in drug-label warnings, right before a named effect, drug class or condition. Examples are 'due to', 'combined with', and the end of 'CNS Depressant'.

modes.label: Linking word before a cause or co-drug
modes.description: Words like 'to' after 'due' or 'with' after 'combined' or 'use', leading into a reason or a second drug.
modes.example: with mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) and corticosteroids [see Clinical Studies ( 14 )] .<< Safety>> and efficacy of LUPKYNIS

modes.label: Inside CNS depressant and drug names
modes.description: Partway through or at the end of 'CNS Depressant' in a section heading, or inside a brand name such as LUMAKRAS.
